note: Phase 11A: adaptive whole-cache KV policy (--kv adaptive). Chooses exactly ONE real storage mode (Q8_0 or Q5_1) for the entire context -- never mixed/per-layer precision. All data below is from real membrane-run invocations (CPU: this host's own CPU; GPU: this host's real GTX 1650 via Vulkan) on this feature branch, not simulated.

policy.name: adaptive_kv_policy
rules: GPU: Q8 chosen if it safely reaches full residency (Q8_FULL_RESIDENCY).
GPU: else Q5 chosen if it safely reaches full residency (Q5_REQUIRED_FOR_FULL_RESIDENCY).

GPU: else, among safe partial-offload plans, Q8 wins ties on layer count (Q8_FITS); Q5 wins only if it offers materially more layers (Q5_REQUIRED_FOR_MEMORY_GUARD) or is the only mode that fits at all (Q5_ONLY_COMPRESSED_MODE_THAT_FITS).
GPU/CPU: neither mode fitting fails closed (NO_COMPRESSED_MODE_FITS) -- never a silent native fallback.
CPU: Q8 by default (CPU_ADAPTIVE_Q8_DEFAULT); Q5 only if an explicit --kv-budget-mib rules Q8 out and Q5 fits (CPU_MEMORY_PRESSURE_Q5).

device.name: Vulkan1
device.note: Real GTX 1650 host, same device used by prior Phase 9B/10C Vulkan validation runs.

cpu_validation_matrix.note: Section 12: q8/q5/adaptive at ctx 2048/8192/16384, CPU only. Confirms adaptive selects Q8 under normal CPU conditions, matching explicit --kv q8's real KV bytes exactly at every context size.

vulkan_validation_matrix.note: Section 13: q8/q5/adaptive at ctx 2048/8192/16384, --gpu-layers auto on the real GTX 1650. Confirms adaptive selects Q8 with full 30/30-layer residency throughout, matching explicit --kv q8's real KV bytes and layer count exactly at every context size.

memory_pressure_transition.note: Section 14: real --gpu-layers auto sweep on the GTX 1650 finding all three zones with actual hardware memory pressure, not simulated. No OOM was forced -- every non-fitting configuration was rejected safely by the existing memory guard before any allocation.

zones.fail_reason: membrane-run: --kv adaptive found no KV storage mode that fits safely: NO_COMPRESSED_MODE_FITS

zone_definitions.A: Q8 safely reaches full residency -- adaptive chooses Q8 (observed ctx <= 120000).
zone_definitions.B: Q8 loses full residency or fails outright, but Q5 still fits (fully or partially) -- adaptive chooses Q5 (observed ctx 131072-200000).
zone_definitions.C: Neither mode fits under any layer count -- adaptive fails closed, exit code 5, no allocation attempted (observed ctx >= 250000).

explicit_vs_adaptive_equivalence.note: Section 15: adaptive is a selection over the SAME run_kv_store_pass()/kv_bytes_for_mode() code path explicit --kv q8/q5 already use -- no new codec or reconstruction logic. Verified bit-for-bit on real runs, not just by code inspection.

compare_and_gpu_bench_adaptive.note: Section 10: --compare-kv/--gpu-bench with --kv adaptive resolve adaptive ONCE (Q8_FULL_RESIDENCY at ctx=2048 on this host) and compare native against that single resolved mode -- verified both commands exit 0 with requested_kv=adaptive/selected_kv=q8 in their JSON output. --compare-kv/--gpu-bench without --kv remain unchanged (default to q8).

fail_closed_behavior.note: Section 11: an unresolvable --kv-budget-mib (smaller than both Q8 and Q5's real KV bytes) produces exit code 5 (MEMBRANE_EXIT_UNSUPPORTED_KV) with reason NO_COMPRESSED_MODE_FITS -- never a silent fallback to native. Verified with a real CPU run.

tests.test_adaptive_kv_policy: 13 llama-free unit tests -- Q8 full residency, Q5-required-for-full-residency, partial-tie prefers Q8, Q5 meaningfully-more-layers, Q5-only-fits, Q8-only-fits, neither-fits fail-closed, near-full-residency boundary, CPU default/budget-forced/neither-fits, determinism (byte-identical repeat calls), NULL input safety. All pass.
tests.test_product_cli: extended with --kv adaptive parse, --kv-budget-mib parse/validation (positive-integer, non-numeric, requires-adaptive rejection for native/q8/q5), help-text coverage. Existing q4/q5_0 alias-rejection tests unmodified and still pass.

performance.note: Section 19: adaptive's own decision overhead is two extra membrane_gpu_policy_resolve() calls (GPU) or none beyond two kv_bytes_for_mode() calls (CPU) -- pure arithmetic, no extra inference pass, no hidden benchmarking. Generation throughput for adaptive-selected Q8/Q5 is within normal run-to-run variance of the equivalent explicit --kv q8/q5 run (see cpu_validation_matrix/vulkan_validation_matrix above).

limitations: GPU adaptive selection is based on a point-in-time free-memory snapshot taken before model load (the same estimate --gpu-layers auto already uses) -- if external GPU usage changes after selection, allocation can still fail. This is not an OOM guarantee.
Adaptive is a whole-cache mode selector only -- it never stores some layers/blocks in Q8 and others in Q5, and it is not quality-aware per token or per layer.
CPU adaptive has no free-memory query to drive its choice (there is no CPU-side equivalent of the GPU memory guard) -- it defaults to Q8 unless --kv-budget-mib is given explicitly.

The GPU transition-zone sweep used one real device (GTX 1650, ~4.55 GiB) and one model (SmolLM2-360M) -- zone boundaries (the specific context sizes) are device/model-specific, not universal constants; only the existence and ordering of the three zones is a general policy property.
Q4_0 and Q5_0 remain research-only (experiment/q4-kv-storage, experiment/q5-kv-evaluation branches) -- adaptive never selects them and the product CLI never exposes them.
